speaker: Kai
text: It listened this time. The flame — it bent when I asked.

speaker: Liora
text: ASKED! See, that's what nobody at this academy understands. They command. You ask. That's why it likes you.

speaker: Kai
text: ...why do you spend all this time on me, Liora? You have your own studies.

speaker: Liora
text: ...huh. You know, no one's ever asked me that.
